1

Details

Reach = the X17/IPC(E1) ratio a 50-day run detects at 3σ (Asimov over the θ histogram; a DC beam has no TOF tag). Every neutron is below 0.5 MeV.

Design baseline: 20 mA DC at 2.0 MeV = 10¹² n/s (the design yield, and the licence's neutron limit). 5.8e+09 n/s through the Ø8 cm spot at 0.5 m give 2,310 singles and 17,650 legs per arm per second; no throttle. The reach is at the IPC + cosmics floor (3.1×10⁻⁴): 2.4 d of beam to ATOMKI.

Licence (IPAC 2025): < 5 % duty and 10¹² n/s. At 10 mA, 5 %: 2.2×10⁻³; at 2.2 MeV (if possible) 1.0×10⁻³. With today's ion source (1 %): 4.9×10⁻³.

Details

Site: experimental hall of the physics building, Max-von-Laue-Str. 1, 60438 Frankfurt (≈ 50.17 N, 8.63 E).

Built for s-process activations and TOF capture with the Karlsruhe 4π BaF₂ array. People (public): H. Hähnel (commissioning), H. Podlech, U. Ratzinger (IAP); users T. Heftrich, K. Göbel.

Sources: Hähnel et al. IPAC 2023 / LINAC 2024 / IPAC 2025; Reifarth et al. arXiv:1403.5670. franz/FACILITY.md.

3

Details

Accelerator: CHORDIS volume source (GSI) + post-accelerator to 60 keV; LEBT; coupled 175 MHz 4-rod RFQ (700 keV) + 1.3 MV IH-DTL (2.03 MeV design). RFQ commissioned with up to 11 mA macro-pulse current (7.1 mA matched, 92.7 % transmission).

Through the Ø8 cm spot at 0.5 m, 2.0 MeV: 2.9e+08 n/s per mA (franz_beam.py, normalised to the design 5×10¹⁰ n/s/mA; the absolute σ/S model gives ×1.5 more, LiLiT's measured yield agrees within ×1.3).

Target design as built, cooling and power limit: (ask). The hall layout: (ask).

³He(n,γ) and IPC fall as 1/v: per neutron the 2.0 MeV spectrum makes 3.4×10⁻⁹ pairs, 0.5 MeV neutrons 6.8×10⁻⁹, thermal 4.8×10⁻¹¹.

At 1.912 MeV every neutron is inside 64°; at 2.0 MeV 0° gets ×3.6 the 4π average.

4

Details

Kinematics: 0° maximum 109 keV at 1.912 MeV (Karlsruhe quasi-stellar field: 25 keV Maxwellian), 231 keV at 2.0 MeV. The low branch below ~30 keV is the backward-CM neutrons that the CM motion carries forward.

The Geant4 neutron run N5 starts at 1 keV: < 0.1 % of the 0° spectrum lies below it (dropped). The NFS signal and IPC tables (lowest bin 0.2–0.75 MeV) are applied at keV energies.

The beam is never throttled: the reach is the IPC + cosmics floor.

At the 10¹² n/s cap, 2.2 MeV gains nothing at DC; under the 5 % duty limit it gains ×2.2.

At a few % duty the DAQ is gated on the macro-pulse, which cuts cosmics ×20–100.

5

Details

Pulsed handling (franz_beam.py): the Geant4 components at the in-pulse rate; signal, IPC, correlated, accidentals and cosmics × duty per day; DREAM live time and Micromegas occupancy at the in-pulse rate. The average yield is capped at 10¹² n/s.

As built hardware, design at 0.5 m: 9.4×10⁻⁴. At 1 m: 7.7×10⁻⁴ (13 d).

Thick Li: ⁷Li(p,γ)⁸Be ~10⁻⁷ γ/p → 30,380 correlated pairs/day in the window, ×3 the IPC.

Thin Li (~12 µm): direct capture only, ~5×10⁻¹⁰ γ/p → 159/day (1.6 % of IPC).

No Pb filter needed: FRANZ already uses ~10 µm evaporated Li (confirm).

6

Details

γ/p: thick 10⁻⁷ (the Birmingham stand-in: 441 keV resonance + 1030 keV + direct capture); thin = n(⁷Li) × σ_DC (≈ 10 µb, estimate) × the 0.6 mg/cm² needed to bring 2.0 MeV protons to 1.881 MeV. ×10 on σ_DC would still leave the correlated term < 20 % of IPC.

Pb (estimate): keV neutrons Σ ≈ 0.36 /cm uncollided, 15–18 MeV γ μ = 0.57 /cm.

The 478 keV ⁷Li(p,p′γ) line makes no trigger legs; its Micromegas occupancy is not modelled.

The background is IPC and cosmics; the beam adds a few per cent

X17 at the ATOMKI ratio is 2.0 % of the IPC in the window.

keV neutrons fire a leg only through capture γ: ~4×10⁻⁷ singles per arm per neutron, and no same-event two-arm pair in the Geant4 sample.

A cosmic veto would remove a third of the background at DC.

7

Details

Window counts are for orientation; the reach uses the whole θ histogram. Accidentals and the correlated term as in the Birmingham and MEDAPP notes (survey/soft_sim/soft_reach.py).

keV neutrons are easy to stop: ~5 cm of borated PE per decade, against ~10 cm at Birmingham’s 0.5 MeV.

But the arms reach ~0.2 m upstream of the cell window: at 0.5 m that leaves ~0.3 m for chamber + shield. At 1 m: 7.7×10⁻⁴, 13 d to ATOMKI.

8

Details

Birmingham's shield() estimate with a 5 cm tenth-value layer (H σ ≈ 18 b at 30 keV, ¹⁰B 1/v; a stand-in). The singles per neutron entering an arm are not simulated: 10⁻⁶–10⁻⁴ spans capture γ in the plastics and SiPM wall. A Geant4 model of the target chamber, shield and hall is the next simulation. out/franz_shield.csv.

What this does not settle yet

Not in the simulation

• Target chamber, shield, hall and room return: leakage is an estimate.

• A diverging beam (±4.6° at 0.5 m): the Geant4 gun is parallel.

• Micromegas occupancy from the 478 keV γ; σ_DC of ⁷Li(p,γ) at 2 MeV.

Facility

• No 2 MeV beam reported yet; schedules have slipped ~1 year per step.

• Licence < 5 % duty; DC at 10¹² n/s is the design, not the plan of record.

• No cosmic veto yet.
